name: Messages Improved
summary: Group MMS fixes, a faster inbox and iMessage
description: Improves the stock Messages app and its providers. Group MMS goes to the right thread, and conversations open faster. Optional iMessage through your own imsg-server: pair with a code under Settings > Advanced settings and the phone registers its number, with SMS fallback.
author: thooton

changes.text: Download iMessage file attachments (PDFs, zips, ...) on demand.
Keep video playback fullscreen without status bar on open, pause/OK, and menu.
Fix RowTextView scroll crash, sent photo inline style, attachment-exit scroll position, and photo fullscreen-before-zoom.
Ship-time AOT + rcs_service_api.jar precompile, cold conversation open deferrals and warm-up.
Batch inbox recipient prefetch, off-main E.164/ICU warm-up, deferred secondary inbox queries, rounded avatar cache, inbox row bind micro-opts.
Strip MIME parameters and allow application/ogg in iMessage media routing.
Cached RTL locale check, zero-alloc Arabic scan replacing per-row Pattern.compile, cached MMS snippet prefix, setTextIfChanged/setVisibilityIfChanged on inbox rows, cached MessageItem config bools.
Non-blocking SharedPreferences XML disk load kick-off at app_start, cache ConversationList config bool and status bar color.
Raise WaveRowPool root harvest timeout to 450ms, chain inbox-row prewarm after inbox-root finishes, mark compose active in obtainComposeRoot.
Defer MessagingNotification.init (with lazy sPduPersister), Contact ContentObserver IPC, and non-critical background threads past frame 1.
